choices.why: A clean-lined light grey three-seater at 234 cm that fills the long left wall and fits the bright, modern room.
Large enough (292x231 cm) to anchor the whole seating area from sofa to TV stand, and its beige-to-charcoal ombre suits the grey wood floor and black window frame.
A simple light wood waterfall table, modern and well sized at 100 cm for a 234 cm sofa.
A low, modern white console that blends with the walls, and its walnut doors tie in with the wood coffee table.
The black arc lamp echoes the balcony door frame and reaches over the sofa with warm light for evenings with friends.
Berber-style cushions with small touches of color, as the user asked, without breaking the neutral palette.
Two white sheer panels soften the wide sliding door while keeping the room bright.

answer.why: Light grey, white and natural wood keep the living room bright and modern, while the black of the lamp and the rug's ombre pick up the balcony frame. The colorful cushions add warmth for having friends over.
